summary.zh: 用最少的代码和依赖完成需求，能不加就不加
summary.en: Write the least code and add no dependency the task does not need

description.zh: 按不做、复用、标准库、平台原生能力、已有依赖的顺序逐级取舍，只写满足需求的最少代码。适合方案越加越复杂、想砍掉多余依赖，或想确认某个功能是否能不引入新东西就完成时使用。
description.en: Applies a ladder from YAGNI to reuse, stdlib, native platform features and existing dependencies, so only the code the task needs gets written. Use it when a design feels bloated or you want to confirm something can ship without new pieces.
